description: Search evaluated gene–drug pairs by gene, literal drug-name substring, exact drug/RxNorm/ATC identifiers, evaluation level or testing label. Filters combine with AND; identifiers never fall back to name-only search. Results include source drug identifiers and guideline links for pgx_get_guideline. A pair evaluation is not a prescribing recommendation. Follow nextOffset to continue.

atcId.description: Exact ATC code (1–7 letters/digits) in any casing, optionally prefixed ATC: in any casing; outer whitespace is ignored and blank means unset.

cpicLevel.description: Exact source CPIC evaluation level, not a prescribing recommendation.

drugId.description: Exact drugId returned by pgx_search_pairs; blank means unset.

drugName.description: Literal case-insensitive drug-name substring; blank means unset.

geneSymbol.description: Exact gene symbol, case-insensitive input; blank means unset.

includeRetired.description: Include Retired pairs; also included when cpicLevel is Retired.

limit.description: Positive safe-integer row limit; values above 100 are clamped to 100 with a notice (default 25).

offset.description: Zero-based offset; use nextOffset to continue (default 0).

pgxTesting.description: ClinPGx label-annotation testing level; not an FDA label.

rxnormId.description: Decimal RxNorm ID, optionally prefixed RxNorm: in any casing; outer whitespace is ignored and blank means unset.

usedForRecommendation.description: Whether the source marks the pair as used for a recommendation.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `query_too_broad`: A bounded source scan or workflow work budget is exceeded. `upstream_query_rejected`: CPIC rejects the generated query. `upstream_rate_limited`: CPIC returns HTTP 429. `upstream_unavailable`: CPIC is unavailable or returns a maintenance page. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
